operations.query: mutation UserEditAddMembership($id: ID!, $group_id: ID!) { userEdit(id: $id) { relationAdd(input: { relationship_type: "member-of", toId: $group_id }) { id from { ... on User { id, name, user_email } } to { ... on Group { id, name, description } } } } }
